_doc: Gift odds by walk length. A walk shorter than min_seconds gives no gift. Each tier gives the odds from its min_seconds, blending into the next tier's as the walk goes on; a rarity a tier doesn't have stays out until the tier that adds it, so legendary starts at 45 minutes. 'guaranteed' is when each rarity becomes the minimum gift: the walk screen's gift button fills with that rarity's colour as the walk approaches it, and rarities below it drop out of the odds. Pity: after pity_walks walks of at least pity_min_seconds without an epic or legendary, the next such walk is guaranteed at least epic.
